speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You've presented with mental status changes; to begin my assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any fever, headache, or recent head injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Carbon monoxide poisoning.

Based on your 30 pack-year smoking history and acute onset of confusion, I suspect carbon monoxide exposure from smoking or a faulty heater. I will order a Carboxyhemoglobin level test and request images of your lungs to check for underlying lung disease that could contribute to this.
